definitions.explanation: The branch of medicine dealing with teeth and oral health, or a clinic or department specializing in dental care.

examples.japanese: {歯科|しか}で{検診|けんしん}を{受|う}けた。
examples.english: I had a checkup at the dentist.

examples.japanese: {歯|は}が{痛|いた}いので{歯科|しか}を{予約|よやく}した。
examples.english: My tooth hurts, so I made an appointment at the dental clinic.

examples.japanese: {半年|はんとし}に{一度|いちど}は{歯科|しか}で{定期|ていき}{検診|けんしん}を{受|う}けるようにしている。
examples.english: I make sure to get a regular dental checkup once every six months.

notes:
USAGE:
In everyday speech, {歯科|しか} and {歯医者|はいしゃ} (dentist) are often used interchangeably when referring to a dental clinic. {歯科|しか} is slightly more formal and refers to the discipline or department, while {歯医者|はいしゃ} is more colloquial and refers to the dentist or the office.

RELATED MEDICAL DEPARTMENTS:
- {眼科|がんか}: ophthalmology
- {皮膚科|ひふか}: dermatology
- {内科|ないか}: internal medicine
- {外科|げか}: surgery

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {歯科医|しかい}: dentist (formal)
- {歯科|しか}{衛生士|えいせいし}: dental hygienist
- {歯科|しか}{検診|けんしん}: dental checkup
- {歯科|しか}{治療|ちりょう}: dental treatment
